favourite.heading: Why Jacksonville State can pull away
bullets: Jacksonville State is the better football team by 4.3 points on opponent-adjusted results — but about 64% of that rating is still last season carried forward, and in a portal era last season is a different team (+4.3 pts).
Playing at Jacksonville State is worth 4.1 points — the league-wide home-field number, because a per-venue table was tested and could not be told apart from the home team’s own quality (+4.1 pts).
Stylistically the matchup favours Jacksonville State by 0.8 points: ball control vs front disruption (+0.8 pts).

underdog.heading: Why Middle Tennessee can keep it close
bullets: The outcome range is 15.3 points wide at one sigma — p10 -13.8 to p90 +30.2 for Jacksonville State, so a projection of +9.2 still produces results a long way either side of it.
It is early enough that both ratings still lean on preseason belief — it widens the outcome range by about 4%.
College ratings are built on twelve-game seasons against wildly uneven schedules; even a clean rating gap carries more estimation error than the number implies.
